killed.claim: Prior iteration-1 finding: --skip-independence-check-because with no reason value immediately followed by another flag (e.g. --waived) was admitted, laundering checkpointOverride.reason == "--waived" onto the ledger row.
killed.impact: A malformed override invocation could silently record a false, misleading reason on the audit ledger instead of being refused.
killed.evidence: Fix verified: flag() returns argv[i+1] unconditionally (spec-review-driver.js:195), so a following '--waived' token used to read as the reason. The new code (spec-review-driver.js ~1100-1103) rejects any raw value starting with '--' by resetting reason to ''. Executed repro: driving a fresh fixture host through --via loop -> reviewer-returned (no stamp) -> --mark dispositions --skip-independence-check-because --waived 0 --rejected 0 --fix-dispatched 0 produced exit status 2, stderr 'spec-review-driver: --skip-independence-check-because needs a non-blank reason...', and review-state.json unchanged with no checkpointOverride key ({"via":"loop",...,"checkpoint":{"sessionId":null}} only). The new test case (d) in tests/review/loop-checkpoint.test.js (AC-20260901-05-4) exercises the identical scenario and passes; full targeted suite run (node --test tests/review/*.test.js tests/provenance/*.test.js) is 204/204 green, including the D2 admitted no-stamp-with-reason case (AC-20260901-05-3) and all four unchanged D2-era regression tests (AC-20260901-05-9), confirming no regression.
